headline: Racing Bulls keep Liam Lawson for 2027
body: Lawson has re-signed and will race alongside rookie Arvid Lindblad, completing the Racing Bulls line-up for 2027. He has scored points in all but four of the 20 races so far and sits ninth in the drivers' standings on 89 points. Racing Bulls lead Alpine by 45 points in the fight for fifth in the constructors' championship.

headline: Williams holds back 2026 aero upgrades to save budget for 2027
body: James Vowles says Williams has aero gains from the wind tunnel that it has not brought to the car, to save cost cap money for 2027. The team has 12 points this season. Vowles said Williams is also treating some Friday running as preparation for the 2027 car.

headline: Audi's Tsunoda appeal will be heard on 25 November
body: The FIA International Court of Appeal will hear Audi's case over the Italian Grand Prix stewards' decision on Yuki Tsunoda at the FIA's Paris headquarters. Audi argues Tsunoda caused the extra formation lap and should have received a stop-and-go penalty. Tsunoda finished seven seconds ahead of Audi's Gabriel Bortoleto, who could gain a point if the penalty is applied.
